- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27386-27417 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The refreshed comments, label events and PR state are checked before a separate label DELETE. A latch writer can post a new head-bound latch after those checks but before the DELETE.
  WHY: Both latch writers post the comment and then add the label. If a new latch lands in this interval, the poller deletes the label using stale snapshots. The next sweep lists only PRs still carrying `ai:needs-human` (line 27282), so it does not revisit the new latch.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27386-27417 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A head-bound latch comment posted after the comments re-read (27386) but before the DELETE (27417) escapes every guard, and the DELETE removes the label unconditionally.
  WHY: GitHub records no `labeled` event for an add of an already-present label, and both writers comment first and then label. After the DELETE the PR has no `ai:needs-human` label, so the next tick's listing (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27282-27283) never revisits it and the new latch comment is orphaned. The last run's tightened marker regex does not change this window.
  (Hardening suggestion, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE 4: after a successful DELETE at 27417, re-read the issue comments once. If a newer trusted comment carries a head-bound latch marker or mentions `ai:needs-human` without a well-formed release marker, re-POST the label and log `NEEDS_HUMAN_HEAD_LATCH pr=<n> outcome=relatch_after_release`. Fail open if the re-read or re-add fails. About 8 lines changed.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
